thread:
clare: Heads-up: noticed console quota alert during edge canary. It looks like proxy pingback + resume path both increment token counters for same logical session.
noah: saw that too. spike around 02:14 UTC. console shows route=test quota breach but runtime logs show single user reconnect.
nash: rough theory: proxy sends a preflight keepalive to detect liveness and emits a metric. Then the runtime resume flow also emits a keepalive charge when it reassigns session -> double count.
clare: exact symptoms: dashboard quota graph shows two near-identical spikes, 1s apart. alert fired and noisy.
jamie: can we short-circuit proxy-origin metrics until resume ack? risk: we might lose valid keepalive charges if resume never happens.
noah: alternative: enrich proxy metric with origin=proxy and propagate proxy.trace to resume. console dedupe could prefer trace_id and ignore origin-tagged duplicates.
nash: quick patch idea: add header X-Keepalive-Origin: proxy on proxy pings. runtime when seeing that header should mark metric as "proxy_pending" and wait up to 500ms for resume confirmation before finalizing charge.
clare: 500ms sounds fine as interim. it will avoid most dupes without delaying charge for healthy sessions.
vik: infra-bot: rollout plan required. canary to 10% edges, monitor token_count and alert rate.
jamie: UX: console should surface a transient banner "Spikes likely due to proxy pingbacks; suppressing alerts" when we detect origin=proxy spikes under threshold.
noah: also add telemetry field keepalive_source with values [proxy,resume,client]. allows posthoc filtering.
nash: logging snippet I grabbed:
```json
{"ts":"2026-01-21T02:14:01Z","event":"keepalive","route":"test","source":"proxy","trace_id":null}
{"ts":"2026-01-21T02:14:02Z","event":"keepalive","route":"test","source":"resume","trace_id":"t-abc123"}
```
clare: see trace_id null on proxy one -> that's why console couldn't dedupe. if we propagate trace_id from proxy->runtime we can make dedupe deterministic.
jamie: longer term: unify keepalive taxonomy and require trace_id propagation at proxy layer. ticket created.
vik: infra-bot: canary deploy started for ash/keepalive-origin-flag (build 6321).
ash: deployed to edge-canary-3. watching metrics: token_count drop ~0.15%. alert churn reduced.
clare: after 20m looks stable. plan to promote and run backfill to correct affected billing windows.
noah: i'll add a console mute rule for the alert group until backfill completes. also add a small explainer in the alert description.
jamie: PR for header + 500ms hold: #8012. PR for trace propagation: #8015.
clare: great work. follow-ups: backfill job, console UX banner copy, postmortem blurb for canary notes.
vik: infra-bot: backfill job queued (job id bf-9203). ETA ~1.5h.
noah: thanks everyone. low-level action: ash, can you add a unit test for cases where proxy pingback has null trace_id and resume fills it?
ash: yep will add tests + integration scenario.
clare: closing thread, will file change log.
